strong_mass.analytic: m(r)=k*r^3, C(r)=2*k*r^2 with R=4, k=0.9/(2*R^2); p=sqrt(3*k/(2*pi*(1-2*k*r^2))), q=0. Regular center, monotone C, outer C=0.9; manufactured constraint solution, not dynamical EKG solution.
strong_mass.criteria: finite geometry, all C<.999, finest C Linf <=.0005, C error order in [1.5,2.5] for both refinements; report mass, lapse and metric diagnostics where analytic reference available; no scientific promotion from synthetic pass.

neutrality: all 19 historical columns byte-identical across paired trials and all CASE fields except elapsed_seconds; additional capture arrays stored separately and not part of historical trace. If baseline pair fails, do not launch instrumented trial. If capture pair fails, no scientific admission. If paired exact but historical differs, environment/other historical difference unresolved, old historical gate remains failed.
